Class ViewResolverRegistry

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.servlet.config.annotation.ViewResolverRegistry
public class ViewResolverRegistry extends Object
协助配置一系列`ViewResolver` 实例。此类预期通过 `WebMvcConfigurer.configureViewResolvers(ViewResolverRegistry)` 使用。
Since:
4.1
Author:
Sebastien Deleuze, Rossen Stoyanchev

    • hasRegistrations

      public boolean hasRegistrations()

    • enableContentNegotiation

      public void enableContentNegotiation(View... defaultViews)
      Enable use of a ContentNegotiatingViewResolver to front all other configured view resolvers and select among all selected Views based on media types requested by the client (for example, in the Accept header).

      如果多次调用，提供的默认视图将被添加到任何已配置的现有默认视图中。

      See Also:
      • ContentNegotiatingViewResolver.setDefaultViews(List)

    • enableContentNegotiation

      public void enableContentNegotiation(boolean useNotAcceptableStatus, View... defaultViews)
      Enable use of a ContentNegotiatingViewResolver to front all other configured view resolvers and select among all selected Views based on media types requested by the client (for example, in the Accept header).

      如果多次调用，提供的默认视图将被添加到任何已配置的现有默认视图中。

      See Also:
      • ContentNegotiatingViewResolver.setDefaultViews(List)

    • jsp

      public UrlBasedViewResolverRegistration jsp()
      Register JSP view resolver using a default view name prefix of "/WEB-INF/" and a default suffix of ".jsp".

      当此方法被多次调用时，每次调用都会注册一个新的 ViewResolver 实例。请注意，由于在不转发到 JSP 的情况下很难确定 JSP 是否存在，因此仅在结合使用 resolver 上的"viewNames"属性（该属性指示哪些视图名称由哪个解析器处理）时，使用多个基于 JSP 的视图解析器才有意义。

    • jsp

      public UrlBasedViewResolverRegistration jsp(String prefix, String suffix)
      Register JSP view resolver with the specified prefix and suffix.

      当此方法被多次调用时，每次调用都会注册一个新的 ViewResolver 实例。请注意，由于在不转发到 JSP 的情况下很难确定 JSP 是否存在，因此仅在结合使用 resolver 上的"viewNames"属性（该属性指示哪些视图名称由哪个解析器处理）时，使用多个基于 JSP 的视图解析器才有意义。

    • freeMarker

      public UrlBasedViewResolverRegistration freeMarker()
      Register a FreeMarker view resolver with an empty default view name prefix and a default suffix of ".ftl".

      注意，您还必须通过添加一个 FreeMarkerConfigurer Bean 来配置 FreeMarker。

    • viewResolver

      public void viewResolver(ViewResolver viewResolver)
      注册一个 `ViewResolver` Bean 实例。这可用于配置自定义（或第三方）解析器实现。当其他注册方法未暴露需要设置的某些高级属性时，也可将其用作替代方案。

    • order

      public void order(int order)
      ViewResolver's registered through this registry are encapsulated in an instance of ViewResolverComposite and follow the order of registration. This property determines the order of the ViewResolverComposite itself relative to any additional ViewResolver's (not registered here) present in the Spring configuration

      默认情况下，该属性未设置，这意味着解析器的顺序为 Ordered.LOWEST_PRECEDENCE；除非启用了内容协商，在这种情况下（如果未显式设置），顺序将更改为 Ordered.HIGHEST_PRECEDENCE。
